Subject: UpWave discovery — post-call commitments & proposed MPA

Hi Olivia (and Tom),

Thanks again for the morning sync — felt like a productive call. Below is a concise recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (attached) to keep momentum. Please confirm owners/dates so we can lock resources on our side.

Key pain & context
- Production latency spikes at peak query volumes (sporadic 95th% > 800ms) hurting conversion on recommendations.
- Current costs for model inference are high relative to throughput — goal is a measurable unit-cost reduction.
- Need to run in a VPC/on-prem-adjacent environment with audit logs & stricter data retention for a regulated workflow.

Top goals (what success looks like for UpWave)
1) 95th percentile generation latency <300ms under target pilot load
2) ~3x reduction in per-token inference cost versus current baseline
3) Security/compliance checklist completed (SOC2 evidence + audit logging)
4) Clear acceptance criteria and decision date for expansion

Proposed milestones & owners (draft — see attached UpWave_MPA_v1.xlsx)
- Oct 12: Finalize SOW & pilot scope (Owners: Olivia; Rachel)
- Oct 19: Security questionnaire & environment access (Owners: Tom; Vanessa)
- Oct 26: Infra mapping & resource estimate (Owners: Karthik; Redwood infra)
- Nov 09: Pilot starts (canary + performance tests)
- Nov 09–Nov 23: Pilot evaluation window (load, latency, cost metrics)
- Nov 30: Decision & procurement (Owners: Olivia; UpWave procurement)

POC acceptance criteria (short)
- Integration: model endpoint consumes UpWave payloads with <50ms added overhead
- Performance: 95th% latency <300ms at stated QPS for 10min sustained window
- Cost: projected per-token inference cost <= target (we'll model this during infra mapping)
- Security: SOC2 questions answered; KMS integration validated

Next steps / asks
- Olivia: confirm the internal decision owner(s) + procurement timeline (proposed Nov 30).
- Tom: confirm who on Eng will own infra access + whether we can schedule a short architecture walkthrough the week of Oct 12.
- UpWave: please add a billing contact to the thread (Alyssa?) so we can capture procurement details.

I've attached the draft MPA and a concise pilot scope PDF. If that all looks good I'll push an updated MPA with final dates on Wednesday.

Thanks — talk soon.

– Rachel
